facts.text: "Doors open at dark. Bring cash, a good coat and your dancing shoes, and leave the trouble outside."
facts.why: Stack never says this. It is in quote marks and signed Stack, so it reads as a film line. A real Stack line is short and sharp.

vibe.verdict: A good looking dark club menu, but it plays like a generic Delta supper and leaves out the film's big scenes.
missing: Sammie's guitar scene where the music pulls spirits through time (the juke joint)
Remmick asking to come in and play, the Irish jig at the door (outside the joint)
Plantation tokens instead of cash at the door (Cornbread on the door)
Annie's mojo bag and fried catfish (Annie helping at the joint)
Garlic water scalding Stack (the storage room)
Bo and Grace Chow painting the sign and supplying food (the grocery)
ideas: Print 'Annie's fried catfish bites' in place of 'Garlic toast', and keep the garlic as a nod to the vampire fight.
Swap 'Smoke and Stack's Irish stout' for 'Remmick's Irish stout, he asked nicely to come in'.
Swap the made up Stack note for a real line from the film.
Add 'We take tokens too, ask Smoke' to the footer, a nod to the plantation tokens at the door.
